feeds.title: My Football Writer
feeds.description: My Football Writer provides you with the latest news, comment and analysis from Norwich City Football Club. The team of professional football writers will not only bring you the breaking stories as they happen, but you'll also get their regular columns on all things of Norwich City.

feeds.title: Oyster Travel
feeds.description: Oyster Travel is an independent Norwich Travel Agent, offering flexible and wide range of professional travel services to meet the clients exact needs. Their mission is to offer unrivaled savings at a selection of hand-picked luxurious destinations, creating unforgettable holidays at affordable prices.

feeds.title: The Landlord Law Blog
feeds.description: An online information service site that has interesting articles, news, and tips on residential landlord & tenant law and practice. It helps landlords and tenants understand their legal rights and obligations.

feeds.title: Boo Roo and Tigger Too
feeds.description: Boo Roo and Tigger Too highlights a journey through motherhood whilst juggling work, childcare, being a wife and having a life. It has evolved to showcase honest reviews, the days out they enjoy as a family along with a mis-match of everything else.

feeds.title: Thou Shalt Not Covet
feeds.description: Thou Shalt Not Covet is a fashion and beauty blog dedicated to Michelle's, the author, obsession with beautiful things, from fashion and make-up, to interiors and lifestyle. She also includes product reviews, vintage finds and looks, and anything else she wants to share with the world.

feeds.title: Official Norwich Airport
feeds.description: Official Norwich Airport website provide details about flight arrivals and departures, car park booking, passenger information, destination list, news and special offers.

feeds.title: The Fabulous Miss K
feeds.description: The Fabulous Miss K is a super stylist and personal shopper with 25 years of experience, specialised in Vintage, lifestyle consultant, event manager, blogger and vintage veteran. KAREN JAMES-WELTON has a wealth of knowledge and believes Vintage is for Everyone.

feeds.title: Norwich Business School
feeds.description: Norwich Business School aspires to be a leading international business school in Norwich at the forefront of business and management education and research, admired for its advocacy of responsible business, and distinguished by its passion to 'do different' and to make a difference for the benefit of its students, staff and the communities it serves.

feeds.title: Veronica Mary Rolf
feeds.description: Julian knew well that 'God is love'. In her mystical theology, she will carry that truth to its fullest implication that God cannot stop loving us because that's who God is.

feeds.title: CrossFit Spitfire Gym Blog
feeds.description: CrossFit Spitfire in Norwich is a fully equipped gym with dedicated, qualified coaches. This Blog gives full body different workout programmes for kids and for any age & ability. The unique exercises and workouts are scalable to suit each individual and their own personal goals. CrossFit community brings together a wide range of people from beginners who are new to fitness and the elite athletes who are looking for a new challenge, both body and mind.

feeds.title: The Fry up Inspector
feeds.description: The Fry up Inspector Blog gives details and reviews about cafes and their breakfast, Street Food and shares their travel experiences.

feeds.title: Love Norwich Food Blog
feeds.description: Love Norwich Food promotes Norwich Independent Food, Cookery School, Recipes, Mystery Diner, Food Tours, a local directory in Norwich. It is a one stop destination for all food and drink of Norwich at one place.

feeds.title: Lipstick, Lettuce & Lycra
feeds.description: Lipstick, Lettuce & Lycra is a Women's Lifestyle blog with covering vintage, fashion, fitness, food, travel and lifestyle issues. It helps you bringing a touch of vintage glamour to a modern life.

feeds.title: Sophar So Good
feeds.description: Sophie, a 27 year old Norwich girl keeps us updated with fashion, lifestyle, travel. Sophar So Good provides information on fashion, life, food, travel and beauty and many more.

feeds.title: Chris Bottrell
feeds.description: Chris Bottrell style is traditional, but with all the values of modern classical that can be seen throughout his work, be it pictures taken for weddings or portraits. The end results are guaranteed to make eyes gleam with joy at the beautiful and personal potrait of ones own story.

feeds.title: Norwich Evening News

feeds.title: Enjoy Norwich Blog
